core_obligations: Record that a monomorphism is separated (proof lines 5585-5587).
Reduce to an affine base Y using locality of local quasi-finiteness (proof lines 5588-5591).
Choose an affine scheme U with an etale morphism U -> X, note U -> Y is of finite type and that U x_X U = U x_Y U, so the projections U x_Y U -> U are etale (proof lines 5592-5596).
Show that every fibre U_y is finite and discrete by embedding it into a fibre of an etale morphism of affine schemes, and conclude that U -> Y is quasi-finite (proof lines 5597-5605).
Conclude that X -> Y is locally quasi-finite since U -> X was an arbitrary affine etale morphism (proof lines 5606-5607).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a monomorphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S which is locally of finite type is separated and locally quasi-finite (source lines 5577-5583). Separatedness is formal from monomorphismhood; local quasi-finiteness is proved after a base change to an affine Y, where one chooses an affine etale U -> X, observes that U -> Y is of finite type and that the monomorphism hypothesis gives U x_X U = U x_Y U, so that the projections U x_Y U -> U are etale; the fibre of U -> Y over y is then a finite discrete set because it embeds into the fibre of the etale morphism U x_Y U -> U, and the criterion for quasi-finiteness in terms of fibres applies.
